'''Astroport Interstellar Services''' was a section at a [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]] owned by the travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]]. [[ROX-N]] acted as the information kiosk staffer to the entrance to the area. In this section were [[Photomorph]] booths, a question and answer program known as [[N'Grid Interviews]], and [[Arcade game/Legends|arcade games]] ''[[Bop a Zot]]'' and [[Starcourse/Legends|''Starcourse'']].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Astroport Interstellar Services, or '''''L'Astroport Services Interstellaires''''' in French, was a location exclusive to the [[Disneyland Paris]] version of [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which effectively acted as a video arcade for those who finished the ride. It was opened [[July 1]], [[1993]], more than a year after the opening of that park's ''Star Tours''.<ref name="Tilt">{{BookCite|author=Feroyd, Morgan|container=IBM atterrit chez Mickey|title=Tilt|number=no. 117|date=September 1993|language=French|link=https://archive.org/details/Tilt117/mode/2up}}</ref> When [[Wikipedia:IBM|IBM]] discontinued its sponsorship of the attraction in [[2005]], it became a traditional video-game arcade.<ref name="Lost Treasures">{{WebCite|url=https://www.designingdisney.com/content/lost-treasures-discoveryland|text=Lost Treasures - Discoveryland|work=Designing Disney|archivedate=20220303153751}}</ref>
